title: Plan Tenure Limits Across Loop+ Membership Plans
content:
Loop+ Membership plans differ in how long a member may hold them. The tenure cap is the maximum number of months a member may hold the plan; a plan with no cap may be held without limit. Where a cap exists, the plan also names the plan the membership moves to when the cap is reached.

| Plan | Maximum months a member may hold the plan | Plan the membership moves to when the cap is reached |
|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | no cap | not applicable |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 48 | Loop+ Monthly |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 48 | Loop+ Annual |
| Loop+ Monthly | no cap | not applicable |
| Loop+ Annual | no cap | not applicable |
| Loop+ Household Annual | no cap | not applicable |

### Definitions

- **Tenure cap**: the maximum months a member may hold the plan, a whole number; shown as no cap when unlimited.
- **Tenure cap rollover plan**: the plan the membership moves to when the tenure cap is reached, named by its official plan name; not applicable without a cap.

### Notes

- Only the two student plans carry a tenure cap, and both carry the same cap of 48 months.
- The rollover plan follows the billing cycle of the student plan: Loop+ Student Monthly moves to Loop+ Monthly, and Loop+ Student Annual moves to Loop+ Annual.
- Loop+ Access Monthly, Loop+ Monthly, Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual have no cap, so no tenure rollover plan applies to them.
